items.title: Buster Williams interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: I did a project for a Japanese singer and I wrote these songs and I wrote lyrics.

ctx.x: She’s a very good singer. And she wants me to write music that fits her in. And a couple of years back I did a project for a Japanese singer and I wrote these songs and I wrote lyrics. And that was the first time I wrote lyrics. And they came out really good. So it’s another challenge that I have in front of me, to write these songs with lyrics. And as you said it stands a better chance of something becoming more standard material.
Well this has been fascinating for me.
